description: Preferred AWS target services by workload category. Used as a post-rubric substitution check — if rubric selects a non-preferred service, substitute the preferred alternative.

entries.notes: Deeper integration with VPC, ALB, IAM, auto-scaling. Alternatives: Lambda (event-driven), EKS (K8s required).
Startups using Auth0, Firebase Auth, Clerk, etc. preserve their existing investment. Do not recommend Cognito.
